health.input: FD 4 health.snapshot snapshot_b64 decoded to opaque bytes
health.decoder: HealthDecoder.decode_snapshot; canon health decoder adapter required
health.bounds: 1..65536 bytes; 90 private cells and 20 corner cells
health.order: canon CHECKS then CORNERS mapped to the pinned geometry
health.repairing: separate presentation set adds a shimmering ring; never changes the evidence cell or v1 snapshot keys
health.unavailable: cleared canvas with an explicit unavailable label

fingerprint.source: gate-aura head service returns the current Aura display head as 64 lowercase hex characters
fingerprint.expansion: PentoraExpansion.pentora_expand takes exactly the 32-byte display digest and returns 110 trits
fingerprint.digit_order: least significant base-3 digit first; increasing global cell index excluding 55
fingerprint.unavailable: cleared canvas; no JavaScript expansion fallback
